# Sensula

> Sensula is a multi-brand online store for original beauty and personal care products: skincare, makeup, haircare, bath & body, fragrance, men's grooming and personal hygiene. It stocks 120+ local and international brands, sourced directly from brands or authorised distributors.

Key facts:
- Delivery: same-day dispatch before 3pm; 1–2 days to major cities, 3–5 days elsewhere; free over $50.00.
- Payment: cash on delivery, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay.
- Returns: 14 days on unopened items.
- Customer care: +1 555 010 2030, care@sensula.com, 9am–9pm daily.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.sensula.com/): categories, bestsellers, brands, offers, FAQ
- [Shop all](https://www.sensula.com/shop.html): full catalogue with filters by category, brand, origin, concern and price
